column3:
[title26][sentence]
這玩意兒的用途你完全猜不透。
它看起來像台高科技行動廁所，
但你總覺得它一定
還有更崇高的目的。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
To the south you see the hut which that
large woman apparently lived in.  You can even smell it
from here.  Blech!
column3:
[title25][sentence]
南邊你看到一間小屋，
那個大塊頭女人顯然就住在裡面。
你甚至在這裡就聞得到味道。噁！

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThis small peninsula seems to be used\nby someone for monitoring weather conditions.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n這個小半島似乎\n有人用來監測天氣狀況。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nThis is the booth that woman appeared and disappeared in.\nIt must be some sort of teleportation device.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這就是那個女人
憑空出現又消失的小亭子。
一定是某種傳送裝置。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nThis is definitely a teleporter booth.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n這絕對是個傳送亭。

column2:
[title25]WRONG NUMBER
As the machine reduces you to a scarlet puddle you hear a
cold mechanical voice chanting: "We're sorry; your call cannot
be completed as dialed.  Please check the number and dial again."
column3:
[title25]號碼錯誤
機器把你化成一灘猩紅水漥的同時，
你聽見一個冰冷的機械音喃喃道：
「很抱歉，您所撥的號碼是空號，
請查明後再撥。」

column2:
[title22][sentence]
You probably shouldn't draw so much attention
to yourself.  You are not, after all, who she
thinks you are.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
你或許不該
讓自己這麼引人注目。
畢竟，你並不是
她以為的那個人。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
You are standing in what appears to be a small
village.  There is only one person here, leaning
against a hut.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
你站在一個看起來像
小村莊的地方。這裡只有
一個人，靠在一間小屋旁。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nShe appears to be watching the chickens.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n她似乎在看那些雞。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThe huts are well made grass and thatch huts.\nOne appears to double as a chicken coop.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這些小屋是用茅草
精心搭建的。其中一間
似乎兼作雞舍。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The chickens are running around in ignorant
bliss.  None of them seem to have
considered WHY they are being fed so well.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這些雞渾然不知，
樂得到處亂跑。
牠們似乎沒有一隻想過，
自己「為什麼」被餵得這麼好。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Even if you could catch it you have no urge
to carry around something that is alive and kicking.
Never mind something that is clawing and pecking.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
就算你抓得到，你也沒興趣
抱著一隻活蹦亂跳的東西到處走，
更別說是又抓又啄的東西了。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThe chicken looks like it has been slowly roasting\non that spit all morning.  It looks like it is just about done.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
這隻雞看起來已經在
那根烤肉叉上慢烤了一整個早上，
差不多快好了。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThis fire pit looks ideal for roasting fowl.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n這個火坑看起來很適合烤禽肉。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nAre you nuts?  That would hurt!
column3: [title19][sentence]\n你瘋了嗎？那會很痛的！

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The stream looks cool and inviting.
Every now and then you see a large
dorsal fin glide by.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
溪水看起來清涼誘人。
你不時會看到一片
巨大的背鰭滑過水面。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
On the opposite bank you see a path
leading through the trees.  The path 
looks overgrown, as if  no one had used
it in years.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
對岸你看到一條小路
穿過樹林。這條路看起來
雜草叢生，像是已經
多年沒人走過。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThose little buggers would still be hungry if you\nfed them a herd of cattle.  Give it up.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
就算餵牠們一整群牛，
這些小傢伙大概還是會餓。
死心吧。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThey look numerous and hungry.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n牠們看起來又多又餓。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThis is obviously where the twinkifruits\ncome from.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n這裡顯然就是\n甜滋果的產地。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThe individual twinkifruits are not yet ripe, and\nthe bush is too big to carry around.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這些甜滋果都還沒熟，
而且整叢灌木也大到
沒辦法帶著走。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nHmmmm.  Didn't you see those odd-looking\nfish in the stream?  You need to be more careful.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
嗯……你沒看到
溪裡那些長相怪異的魚嗎？
你得小心一點。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nYou aren't currently of the correct gender for\nthat type of activity.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n你現在的性別\n不適合做那種事。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nYou discover nothing new.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n你沒發現什麼新東西。

column2:
[title27]BINOCULARS
Taking your trusty binoculars off the hook reveals
a previously obscured portion of the poster.  You
spend a few moments studying it.
column3:
[title27]望遠鏡
把你那可靠的望遠鏡從掛鉤上取下，
露出了海報先前被遮住的部分。
你花了點時間仔細端詳。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
You stare at the lamp...  You stare some more...
Realizing you may soon spend the rest of your life
wearing sunglasses and being led around by a dog
you decide to do something productive.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
你盯著那盞燈……又盯了一會兒……
意識到自己可能得
戴著墨鏡、靠導盲犬帶路
度過餘生，你決定
做點有意義的事。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Maybe if you stare at it long enough,
something really important will happen
that will help you escape from this planet - NOT!
column3:
[title27][sentence]
或許盯著它看久一點，
就會發生什麼重要的事，
幫你逃離這顆星球——
才怪！

column2:
[title17]LOOK THROUGH DOOR
The door leads back to the ship's
cockpit.  If you walk towards it
"real fast", it will open for you
automatically (honest it will).
column3:
[title17]透視艙門
這扇門通往太空船的
駕駛艙。如果你
「用衝的」走向它，
它就會自動幫你打開
（真的，不騙你）。

column2:
[title19][sentence]
If you were to walk in that direction,
you would wind up in the ship's engineering
section, where you could check out the
damage to the hyperdrive firsthand.
column3:
[title19][sentence]
如果你往那個方向走，
就會走到太空船的工程區，
可以親眼看看躍遷裝置
受損的狀況。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
Being the man that you are you can't help
but to briefly pause and admire yourself in 
the medicine cabinet mirror.  You are elated 
to see that the hideous cold sore you "earned"
last month has finally cleared up.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
以你這種男人的個性，
總忍不住要在醫藥箱鏡子前
稍微駐足欣賞自己一番。
你很高興地發現，上個月
「賺到」的那顆噁心唇皰疹
終於消了。

column2:
[title27]MEDICINE CABINET
Well, let's see... you've got a couple of
old toothbrushes, a used up stick of deodorant
from last year you were saving "for an
emergency", and that festering pile of dried-up
toothpaste left over from when the 'Crust' tube
exploded a couple of years ago.
column3:
[title27]醫藥箱
嗯，讓我瞧瞧……有兩支舊牙刷、
一條去年就用完、
你留著「以備不時之需」的體香劑，
還有幾年前那條『痂膏』牙膏
爆漿後留下的一坨
發黴乾掉的牙膏渣。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The door creaks open once again, revealing
(once again) your sordid collection of
bathroom implements.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
門又嘎吱一聲打開，
再次展現出你那堆
不堪入目的衛浴用品收藏。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The medicine cabinet door creaks shut,
and you remind yourself that one of these
days you're going to have to have that
toothpaste sandblasted off of the bottom
shelf.  For now, though, you decide to let
it ferment in peace.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
醫藥箱門嘎吱一聲關上，
你提醒自己，總有一天
得把最底層那坨牙膏
用噴砂機才刮得掉。
不過現在，你決定
讓它繼續安靜地發酵。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
It's a cute little chair that you're
supposed to sit in while you eat dinner.
You never sit in it though, finding it
more convenient to drag a sandwich up
to the cockpit and get crumbs all jammed
in between the buttons on the console.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這是張可愛的小椅子，
本來是給你吃晚餐時坐的。
不過你從來沒坐過，
覺得直接把三明治拖到
駕駛艙吃比較方便——
順便把餅乾屑塞滿控制台的按鈕縫。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Better not.  The many fluids that have been
spilled on this chair have formed a new adhesive.
You might never get up again.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
還是別坐好了。
這張椅子上灑過的
各種液體已經形成一種新型黏膠，
你可能就再也起不來了。
